result.process_description:
First, the implements are prepared, the hands are washed, and the doctor gets in sterile clothes.
The doctor cleans the puncture area, and drapes the puncture zone.
The doctor configures the ultrasound, and puts gel in the probe.
Then, the doctor covers the probe and puts the sterile gel.
The doctor positions the probe and positions the patient.
The vein is identified using an anatomic identification, a doppler identification, or a compression identification.
The patient is anesthetize and punctured.
The blood return is checked.
If the blood return is not correct, the doctor goes back to the puncture step.
If the blood return is correct, the probe is dropped and the syringe is removed.
The guidewire is installed, and the trocar is removed.
Then the wire is checked using a check of the wire in the long axis, or a check of the wire in the short axis.
Then, the doctor checks if the wire is in good position.
If the wire is not in the good position, the doctor goes back to the puncture step.
If the wire is in the good position, the pathway is widen, the catheter is advanced, and the guirewire is removed.
Finally, the doctor verifies the flow and the reflow, and the catheter position is checked.

result.rule: Several unconditional outgoing flows from one activity can all proceed. Use a gateway when the description requires a decision or synchronization.

Give every process and every expanded subProcess its own explicit start event and end event. A trigger that occurs after the main flow (for example later feedback or a return) is joined to the main flow by a gateway, or modeled as an event subprocess or a separate process.
An ordinary embedded subprocess participates in normal sequence flow and may contain its own starts, ends, activities, gateways and flows.
Use an event-based gateway when the first occurring event selects the path. Target supported catching events or receive tasks, not ordinary tasks.
Give the outgoing sequence flows of an event-based gateway no conditionExpression; the first occurring target event selects the path.
Build a connected path from each modeled start to an end or intentionally continuing state. Avoid accidental disconnected flow nodes.

result.rule: When the description says an additional activity may be performed before a later activity that follows regardless: Model the additional activity as a distinct optional path that rejoins the main flow before the later shared activity.

When the description says an initial item is checked, and when a completion condition is not met, another item is selected before the same check is repeated: Route the initial entry and the repeat path through a shared merge gateway before the repeated check, keeping the item-selection activity on the repeat path. Route the completed outcome to the subsequent work described.

When the description makes a later activity depend on the outcome of an evaluation and specifies a different response for the other outcome: model an exclusive gateway before the later activity to route each outcome to its corresponding path

When the description states that a sequence of activities repeats until a completion condition is met, and then describes subsequent work: Model a decision at the completion check, route the incomplete outcome back to the repeated activities, and connect the completed outcome to the subsequent work.
